test_title: PYST 26: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 23 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Six letters V, C, R, E, X and Z are written on different faces of a dice. Two positions of this dice are shown in the figures below. Find the letter on the face opposite to C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0434dd48f32591614f8313b5dcb10cdd954b42dc03f557c084bf91aaa124f291.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f6229d149e9b5cc72df49bebaa0645b7c0ffef6fe8373bcbb9b76d19dc2798e.png]
solution:
For find the opposite surface of 'C', we need to compare the common surface in the given dices,

So, From Dice 1 and Dice 2,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d12bcce5ad838d204ac2cc1c0466464331ca1b67f591e63100cbe69a944f0ed9.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a752606db73b8c2eb837f31ac72e59b153a96f7c1e36f35e1f834c4bdca8d6f5.png] 

From both dices, R is common and on the same surface. So, all remaining surface will be opposite to each other.

R → Z

C → X

V → E

V is opposite to E.

So, X will be opposite to C.

Hence, the correct answer is "X".
